title: The Softening
logline: A drum-maker works a stiff, raw hide with oil and water for days until it can finally be stretched, tuned and played.
human_question: What has to happen to something rigid before it can be made useful?

premise.story: The full process of preparing a drumhead in a family workshop, from raw hide to a tested, tuned sound.
premise.place: A village workshop belonging to a family with a generations-old drum-making tradition.
premise.experience: Watching material resistance slowly give way to usefulness, and hearing the first true note the finished drum makes.

concept_links.why: Softness is pictured as a stiff hide worked with oil and water until it can be used, opposed to the rigidity of a fixed position [C023-P:L141].
A specific, ordinary capacity, here the skill of working hide, is shaped entirely by what it is put to serve [C019-P:L61-L63].

what_camera_could_observe: Soaking and working the hide by hand
Stretching it over the drum body
Testing tension by ear, tightening and adjusting
The maker's hands, patience and small corrections over days
what_must_be_real: The maker's actual craft, livelihood and working process. Nothing staged purely to serve the metaphor.

possible_arc.opening: A stiff, unusable hide, freshly prepared.
possible_arc.turn: Days of soaking, working and stretching it.
possible_arc.ending_open: The first sound the finished drum makes, and whatever the maker says about it, or doesn't.

requirements: A working family drum-making household willing to show the full process over enough time
A drum currently in production, not one made only for filming
The maker's willingness to speak about the craft and its economics

suggestions.name: A traditional drum-making household
suggestions.region: Kandy district or the wider hill country
suggestions.why: The Kandy area has long-standing traditional drum-making communities linked to ritual and dance music.
suggestions.verify: No specific household, maker or drum has been identified or confirmed.

risks: Animal-hide processing may disturb some viewers and needs careful, honest framing
Turning a living tradition into pure metaphor rather than letting the craft and the maker lead
drop_if: No maker is willing to show the full process, or the craft is no longer practised at the identified location

connections.note: Both use a real, physical process as the direct image of a beautiful factor: softness here, lightness there.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
